Summarize a flexCountReg model

summary.flexCountReg.Rd

Summarize a flexCountReg model

Usage

# S3 method for class 'flexCountReg'
summary(object, level = 0.95, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.flexCountReg'
print(x, digits = x$digits, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.flexCountReg'
as_tibble(x, ...)

Arguments

object

A flexCountReg model object.

level

the confidence level for the confidence intervals. Default is 0.95.

...

Optional arguments. The arguments confint_level and digits of earlier versions are still accepted.

x

a summary.flexCountReg object.

digits

the number of digits (decimal places) to round to when printing. Default is 3.

Value

An object of class summary.flexCountReg, a list with coefficients (a matrix with the estimate, standard error, z value, p-value and confidence limits of every parameter), vcov_type, logLik, AIC, BIC, nobs, n_groups, n_dropped, converged, offset and lr_test. Printing it shows the results. Use tibble::as_tibble() on it for the coefficient table as a tibble (the value returned by summary() in earlier versions), or tidy.flexCountReg.

Details

The standard errors are those chosen when the model was fit: Hessian-based, robust (sandwich), or bootstrapped. The z statistics and p-values use the normal distribution.

For countreg() models of families that nest the Poisson model, a likelihood-ratio test against a Poisson model with the same mean specification, rows, offset and weights is reported. For one-parameter mixtures where the Poisson model lies on the boundary of the parameter space (NB1, NB2, PLN, PIG1, PIG2, PIG, PL), the p-value is halved (a 50:50 mixture of chi-square distributions with 0 and 1 degrees of freedom).

Examples

# \donttest{
data("washington_roads")
nb2 <- countreg(Total_crashes ~ lnaadt + lnlength + speed50,
                data = washington_roads, family = "NB2",
                dis_param_formula_1 = ~ speed50, method = "BFGS")
s <- summary(nb2)
s
